correctness.rationale: The two-missing-leaves obstruction proves no successful set is outside the 16 possible seed types. All seeded ordinary leaves can act only in round one and contribute exactly alpha to their white hub. Restricting to the hubs and at most two omitted leaves is then an exact weighted process quotient. A newly filled hub occurs by round two; any remaining leaf by round three. This proves the 16-term polynomial, the alpha>=beta factorization and the nonmonotonic counterexample for all quantified inputs. An independently coded full labelled graph simulation matches every coefficient for 576 graph/parameter combinations but is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The complete all-seed polynomial for an infinite diameter-three tree family with arbitrary positive transmission and threshold parameters is a natural exact invariant of a recently introduced model. A nontrivial structural leaf-deficit lemma gives fixed-size parameter-independent compression and a sharp uniform propagation cutoff. An explicit tree exhibits parameter-sensitive failure of monotonicity under adding seeds. The weighted all-seed classification, not ordinary forcing at beta<=alpha or a generic brute-force calculation, supplies the value.
